tr: Şirket yeni bir pazarlama stratejisi uyguladı.
en: The company executed a new marketing strategy.

tr: Görevi hızlı ve verimli bir şekilde yerine getirdi.
en: He executed the task quickly and efficiently.

tr: İş yerinde çok fazla baskıya dayanabildi.
en: She was able to withstand a lot of pressure at work.
The company managed to withstand the economic crisis.

tr: Sonuç ne olursa olsun seni destekleyecek.
en: He will support you irrespective of the outcome.
They continued the project irrespective of the difficulties.

tr: Hava nasıl olursa olsun etkinlik gerçekleşecek.
en: Irrespective of the weather, the event will take place.
She treats everyone equally irrespective of their background.
I can't run 5 kilometers, much less a marathon.
